set.body: Epic phase 5 (DesignGraphics migration) was EXCLUDED from the graphics hardening commit series (bd-01KX30QRRTT67YQ51QV5Q7N6X1) because it is entangled with non-graphics work. modules/design/.../DesignGraphics.scala (+ DesignGraphicsSuite) depend on DesignExportError, which does not exist in HEAD — it is introduced only by the uncommitted rework of DesignExports.scala (design-export / contrast / selector work). Committing DesignGraphics alone would not compile in isolation; committing it with DesignExports would drag unrelated files into the graphics series, violating the 'no unrelated files' acceptance rule. Both files remain untracked in the working tree. Action: land DesignGraphics + its suite once the DesignExports/contrast/selector rework (and the design->graphics build.sbt dep at build.sbt:38) is committed, verifying designJVM/test + designJS/test green. Part of epic bd-01KX30QRM91PC04H73T4XX40H5.
set.title: Graphics: land DesignGraphics migration once design-export rework is committed
